text:
alex_support: FYI we have an escalated support ticket from ACME (acct acme-corp). After last night's failover their traffic appears to have hit us-east-1 instead of eu-west-1. Customer got a data-residency compliance alert and saw auth errors + latency spikes. Ticket #INC-12345.

compliance-bot: [ALERT] DATA-RESIDENCY-VIOLATION: policy=eu_residency org=acme-corp audit_id=arb-202-177890. Reason: request routed to us-east-1 (region mismatch).

priya_sre: Can you paste a sample request id + approximate client timestamp? Also need the route decision log for that req id.

alex_support: Sample: req=6a9f3c2b, client_ts=2026-05-11T03:14:22Z, endpoint=/v1/generate, org=acme-corp. Response: 200 for some requests but many 403/401 and a couple timed out at ~2.3s. Customer says they saw an automated compliance email at 03:15 UTC.

mateo_runtime: Looking at routing history for org acme-corp: I see auto_fallback enabled and region_routing policy set to prefer eu-west-1 but fallback chain includes us-east-1. At 03:14 we had two eu capacity nodes full for that pool; the router elected fallback and routed ~13 requests to us-east-1.

alex_support: Repro steps from customer: 1) set region=eu in SDK (they're explicit). 2) send /v1/generate with header `X-Org-ID: acme-corp`. 3) observe in 1/20 calls that the response latency jumps and audit alert fires.

priya_sre: Can you run and paste the small routing query? e.g.:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL" "https://router.internal/api/v1/route?org=acme-corp&region=eu-west-1&trace_id=6a9f3c2b"
```
Expect to see policy evaluation + fallback_reason.

alex_support: Pasted output from customer-side and our logs earlier: `policy=eu_residency; eval=prefer_eu; fallback=true; fallback_reason=capacity; routed_to=us-east-1; audit_event=arb-202-177890`

claire_security: Important: if org has residency constraint, fallback to a different region must be treated as a policy exception and flagged for legal/compliance. Also check KMS/HSM key region bindings — cross-region crypto ops can return 403s.

jake_oncall: I'm on it. Temporary mitigation plan: 1) pin acme-corp to eu-west-1 model variant (disable auto_fallback) 2) throttle retries that cause cross-region routing 3) extract full audit logs and hand to Compliance. Applying pin now (rolling change).

mateo_runtime: Command I'm running to pin:
```
POST /internal/config/orgs/acme-corp/pinning
{ "region": "eu-west-1", "auto_fallback": false }
```
Rolling change started -> canary at 03:25 UTC.

compliance-bot: [AUDIT_EXPORT] export_id=exp-177890-a1 ready for download at s3://redwood-internal-exports/acme/exp-177890-a1.json (contains route decisions, trace ids, auth status).

alex_support: Told customer: "We started a pin to eu-west-1, investigating root cause and exporting audit logs. You may see reduced retries; we'll update asap." Customer asked about billing for failed requests — flagged to billing.

priya_sre: Post-mortem plan: 1) verify pin prevented further cross-region routing over 24h, 2) analyze capacity spikes (why both eu nodes were saturated), 3) add a policy-level guard: for residency-sensitive orgs, auto_fallback must be opt-in and generate high-priority alerts.

claire_security: Also action: search audit export for any decrypted payloads processed outside eu-west-1. If any PII/regulated data found -> legal notification. I'm starting the scan.

jake_oncall: Quick note: while pinning, watch for increased latency if eu nodes remain overloaded. We'll open a capacity burst for acme-corp if needed.

alex_support: Filing escalation doc now (INC-12345-escalation). I'll attach the export and timeline once you post it. Customer wants confirmation of no data egress within 48h.

priya_sre: I'll add an alert rule: residency-policy-violation -> pager to oncall + auto-block fallback for orgs with residency=true.

claire_security: Please keep all audit IDs in the doc. Exported file name: exp-177890-a1.json.

alex_support: Thanks team. Action items: Jake pin + capacity burst, Mateo gather route traces, Priya update alerting + postmortem, Claire run residency scan and advise legal. I'll update the customer and compliance. Closing thread when audit export and doc attached. :thumbsup:
